0.0: So, you just want the film? Not trying to save the camera itself?
0.1: Weird, but if you're coming to me, this is no ordinary camera.
0.2: But you tell me, do you have the dough?
0.3: Tell you what, I'll do it for the low-low price of #r100,000 Mesos#k. What do you say?

1.msg: Sit tight. I'll be right back.

QuestInfo.name: [Aqua Road] In the Camera's Eye
QuestInfo.0: You meet Han the Broker in Magatia. Will he be able to salvage the film?
QuestInfo.1: Han the Broker requests 100,000 Mesos to develop the film and upon getting paid, sets to work. What he found was unbelievable...
QuestInfo.2: There was one clue left: the flashlight. The only person who could help was Carta the Sea Witch.
